newsitem.title: USA: MedPlus says oks 1-for-3 reverse split.
newsitem.headline: MedPlus says oks 1-for-3 reverse split.

text.p: MedPlus Corp said Monday its board has declared a one for three reverse stock split.
MedPlus said any fractional shares that result from the split will be rounded up to the next whole share.
The new stock certificates would be issued in the normal course of business whenever the appropriate transfer was requested by the shareholders.
The company said the authorized shares and the par value would remain the same.
The company said the reverse stock-split is effective Monday, the day of this annoucement.
